sections.title: 3.1 Generate and nurture leads
sections.html:
Skills measured: Configure the lead and opportunity experience • Fine-tune the predictive scoring model. In a sandbox Sales Hub, qualify a test lead with each qualification setting, turn on duplicate detection, then edit, retrain and compare a lead scoring model (creating the model itself is covered in §2.3).

Configure the lead and opportunity experience

Most lead and opportunity behaviour is set in Sales Hub under Change area → App Settings. Know which page holds which switch.

SettingPathKey facts
Lead qualificationGeneral Settings → Lead + Opportunity management → Lead QualificationTry the new lead qualification experience is on by default and exists only in Sales Hub. The legacy option Automatically create records for newly qualified leads creates account, contact and opportunity. If both are off, sellers are prompted to choose the records.
Opportunity Close formGeneral Settings → Lead + Opportunity management → Opportunity managementCustom fields on closing form = Yes (Unified Interface only). Then add columns to the Opportunity Close Quick Create and Main forms, map opportunity fields to pre-populate them, adjust Status Reason, publish.
Duplicate lead detectionData improvement → Duplicate detection → Enable rulesAI model rules: same email, same phone, similar lead name and company, similar lead name with the same email domain.
Email validation PreviewData improvement → Email validationOff by default; needs Preview and experimental AI models (called AI Builder preview models before August 2025); checks only the primary email of leads and contacts that are not older than 180 days (bad syntax, invalid or unknown domain, expired domain).
Opportunity pipeline viewGeneral Settings → Opportunity pipeline viewDefault list is the read-only grid; add the Pipeline view control (grouping and aggregation on) to the main form to make it the default. Details in §4.1.

New lead qualification experience. For each record type (account, contact, opportunity) choose who creates it when a lead is qualified: Seller (the seller creates, reuses an existing record or skips) or Automatic (the system creates; sellers can review). Duplicate detection rules still apply either way.

  • Only when opportunity creation is Seller: Modify opportunity form → Add or remove fields (edits the Quick create form) and Let seller create up to 5 opportunities from a newly qualified lead.
  • Custom apps must include the Opportunity qualify lead Form component, or sellers can't edit or create opportunities in the Qualify lead pane.
  • Optional Copilot lead summary card after qualification (requires Copilot to be enabled, §2.3).
  • Legacy web client: Advanced Settings → System Settings → Sales tab → Create Account, Contact, and Opportunity records by default upon qualifying a lead (Yes/No).

Duplicate detection does not work? Turn the feature off, then confirm in order: Dataverse search is on; firstname, lastname, emailaddress1, telephone1 and companyname are in the Quick Find All Leads view's Find by list; the processes CheckForDuplicatesAction, DuplicateDetectionTriggerAction and GetDuplicatesAction are active; roles have read on Process; then turn it on again. Microsoft recommends disabling Power Platform duplicate detection for leads so the two don't overlap.

Exam traps
  • The five-opportunity option and the opportunity form editor appear only when the opportunity record type is set to Seller.
  • With both qualification options off, sellers are prompted to choose which records to create.
  • The close-form toggle is under Opportunity management, not Lead Qualification.
  • Email validation is preview, primary email only, leads and contacts only.
  • Sales duplicate detection (AI model) is not the same feature as Power Platform duplicate detection rules.

Fine-tune the predictive scoring model

Tune a model when Model performance is weak, the data or process has changed, or the model is old. Open it under Sales Insights settings → Predictive models.

  1. Open the model and make sure Retrain automatically is off.
  2. Select Edit model. Pick attributes (custom attributes included) from the lead plus contact and account, or from the opportunity plus account; review Attribute Insights; for lead scoring optionally add intelligent fields; for opportunity scoring with per-stage modelling set Applicable stages.
  3. Optionally turn on Ignore empty values for an attribute.
  4. Select Retrain model (a few minutes), then optionally turn Retrain automatically back on.
  5. Check View details → Performance; Publish if satisfied, otherwise edit again or Revert version (only for a retrained, unpublished model).
Symptom or goalLever
Blank values behave as a negative signal or cause false positivesIgnore empty values (off by default; unavailable for presence-based attributes such as zip code or business phone and for auto-validated attributes)
Score should distinguish business from personal email or valid namesIntelligent fields: Email domain validation, First name validation, Last name validation
Why does a value raise or lower the score?Attribute Insights: qualification rate of each value against the global rate (past two years; models created before March 2021 need retraining to show it)
Attribute matters only in some stagesPer-stage model (opportunity scoring; enabled only when adding the model; needs 40 closed in the last stage)
Test or bad data in the training windowShorter training period or tighter filter column and values
Retrained model is worseRevert version; or Retrain with recommended fields to return to out-of-the-box attributes

Retraining rules. Retrain automatically runs every 15 days and is on by default after publishing. The retrained model is published automatically only if its accuracy is at least 95 percent of the active model's accuracy or the active model is more than three months old; otherwise the current model stays. Manual retraining means editing the model. Attributes on custom tables, date and time attributes and system-generated attributes (such as leadscore or predictive score ID) are not supported.

Metric (Performance tab)Meaning
Accuracy(TP + TN) / records scored
RecallTP / (TP + FN)
Conversion rate(TP + FN) / records scored — share that actually qualified or won
AUC, F1, thresholdAUC drives Ready, OK or Not ready to publish; F1 suits unbalanced data; the threshold (chosen to optimise F1) is the score above which a record is predicted qualified or won

The model trains on 80 percent of closed records and is validated on the most recent 20 percent. If a new model would score the same records as an existing one you are warned (No, Go back or Yes, Create model); a published duplicate can be edited or deleted (retrain automatically must be off to delete).

Exam traps
  • Auto-retrain interval is 15 days; the automatic publish thresholds are 95 percent and three months.
  • You must switch Retrain automatically off before editing the model.
  • Per-stage modelling and Applicable stages belong to opportunity scoring; intelligent fields belong to lead scoring.
  • Revert version is possible only before the retrained model is published.
  • Recall uses false negatives, not false positives; conversion rate is (TP + FN) over all scored records.

sections.title: 3.2 Automate lead qualification by using the Sales Qualification Agent
sections.html:
Skills measured: Evaluate use cases for Research-only mode configuration versus Research and engage mode configuration • Configure the Sales Qualification Agent • Interpret the actions of the Sales Qualification Agent • Monitor the Sales Qualification Agent. In a sandbox, create the agent user, configure a Research-only agent, process about ten test leads, then upgrade to Research and engage and read the supervisor dashboard. Capacity, billing and prerequisites shared by all agents are in §2.2; the segment and assignment logic the agent shares with work assignment is in §2.3.

Evaluate use cases for Research-only mode configuration versus Research and engage mode configuration

The Sales Qualification Agent (SQA) is an autonomous AI agent that works leads that match your selection criteria. It speeds up qualification and does not replace seller judgement. It runs in one of two modes.

CapabilityResearch-onlyResearch and engage
Research the lead (background, company news)YesYes
Check target customer profile (TCP) criteriaYesYes
Check BANT criteriaNoYes
Generate outreach emailsYesYes
Send outreach emailsNoYes
Detect positive intent in repliesNoYes
Send follow-ups and clarify questionsNoYes
Hand over promising leads to sellersYesYes
Notify supervisors about disqualified leadsYesYes
SituationChoose
Sellers must review and send every outreach email themselves; you want research, fit scoring and a draftResearch-only
You want to build trust in the agent's research before allowing autonomyResearch-only, upgrade later
Very high inbound lead volume; you want automatic first contact, follow-ups, intent detection and only interested, BANT-fit leads handed overResearch and engage
Qualification must use budget, authority, need and timelineResearch and engage
  • Only one mode can be deployed per organization. You can upgrade Research-only to Research and engage (research settings are kept; the agent returns to Draft until reconfigured and started) but downgrading isn't supported.
  • Research and engage adds a shared mailbox with server-side synchronization, an email signature, an AI disclaimer, optional compliance settings, BANT criteria and a mandatory outreach email simulation before the agent can start.
  • Handover differs: Research-only hands over leads with high or medium TCP fit and disqualifies low fit; Research and engage hands over when TCP and BANT are met with positive intent, when intent can't be detected, or when the agent is blocked by a question it can't answer.
  • Status: the overview and setup pages carry no preview label for either mode. Preview Personalised outreach emails. Sales Opportunity Agent and Sales Close Agent are separate agents (§4.1, §4.2); Deprecated the Sales Close Agent (preview) is being replaced by the Sales Development agent (preview): since September 30, 2026 new Sales Close Agent instances can't be created, and existing instances will be removed on October 30, 2026.
Exam traps
  • Research-only generates the outreach email; only Research and engage sends it.
  • BANT, follow-ups and intent detection are engage-only; TCP checking, hand over and supervisor notification exist in both.
  • A mix of both modes in one organization isn't allowed; the path is upgrade, never downgrade.
  • Choosing the engage mode means more prerequisites, not just a different toggle.

Configure the Sales Qualification Agent

Open Change area → App Settings → General settings → Dynamics 365 AI hub → Agent manager → Create and manage agent → Create → Sales Qualification Agent → Choose. Research is always selected; add Engage for the second mode. The Create option stays disabled until the common prerequisites are Done: Copilot Studio capacity, Move data across regions (accept terms) and AI prompts, plus AI insight cards and AI Agents turned on in the Power Platform admin center.

PrerequisiteDetail
Licence and platformCopilot Studio licence; modern UI on for Sales Hub; admin permissions in Sales
Data policiesAllow Knowledge source with public websites and data, Microsoft Copilot Studio, Microsoft Dataverse, Direct Line channels in Copilot Studio (plus SharePoint/OneDrive and document connectors if internal documents are used)
EmailServer-side synchronization with Exchange; without it the agent doesn't generate outreach emails or engage. The Draft email and Review email buttons also need it and a lead email address.
NotificationsIn-app notifications enabled for handover alerts
Agent user (both modes)Register an app in Microsoft Entra ID (Application Developer role); create a Dataverse application user in the Power Platform admin center with security role AIsalesperson (needs System Administrator)
Engage mode onlyCreate a shared mailbox in Exchange admin center; configure server-side sync for it (Approve Email; Appointment, Contacts and Tasks = None; Test & Enable Mailbox)

Configuration order:

  1. Complete the agent-user prerequisites and tick Mark as done for each.
  2. General: agent profile (name, purpose, agent user, agent language; engage adds signature, AI disclaimer, other terms), company name and website, product value proposition, connected skills (Recommended Actions on by default).
  3. Selection criteria (Guidance section): a segment with up to 10 conditions. Defaults: Status = Open, Rating = Cold, Lead Source does not equal Employee Referral and Partner, Email contains data. Only new leads created after the agent starts are considered unless you select Consider leads created in the last N days. Use Preview leads.
  4. Email instructions: AI-personalization or a fixed email template (no generative AI, no Copilot credits); compliance profile for engage; the email field used for validation (default emailaddress1).
  5. Handoff criteria: TCP (industry, size, roles, location, revenue; Generate builds it from your product value proposition) and, for engage, BANT. Fields must be on the lead or a directly related table (no Lead > Account > Industry); custom criteria map to a Dataverse field or a public website URL.
  6. Assignment rules: sellers or teams (teams get leads round robin) and a supervisor (Sales Manager recommended).
  7. Knowledge sources: public web by default; add company, competitor, outreach and follow-up sources through Copilot Studio micro agents (files must be in SharePoint, chosen from the Featured SharePoint option); optional custom research insights.
  8. Engage mode: run the outreach email simulation (consumes capacity). Start agent is enabled only when every section has a green check mark and, for engage, the simulation is complete.
  • The agent's selection segment has low priority, one above the default segment. If a work assignment segment overlaps, leads go to sellers instead of the agent. The lead owner of new leads must not be the agent's app user.
  • Sellers with the out-of-the-box Salesperson or Sales Manager role need nothing more; custom roles need the listed table privileges (for example Sales Agent Handover read/write). Sales Hub includes the views My leads from AI Agent, Leads disqualified by AI Agent, Leads handed over by AI Agent and Leads being processed by AI Agent; custom apps must add them.
  • Export and import the agent as a solution to move it from sandbox to production. A configured agent can't be deleted by the admin; contact Microsoft Support.
Exam traps
  • The application user's role is AIsalesperson, not Salesperson.
  • Start agent greyed out with all sections green usually means the engage-mode simulation isn't finished.
  • Overlap with a work assignment segment sends leads to sellers, because the agent segment ranks lower.
  • Knowledge-source files must be in SharePoint (Featured option); OneDrive or the Upload file option isn't supported.
  • Both modes need the Azure app and app user; the shared mailbox and mailbox sync are the engage-mode extras.

Interpret the actions of the Sales Qualification Agent

ConceptHow the agent decides
TCP fitHigh = more than 70 percent of TCP attributes match; Moderate = 50–70 percent; Low = below 50 percent
Purchase interest (engage)Read from email replies as positive (high, medium or low intent) or negative (high or medium) with a reason used in the handover summary
BANT (engage)Evaluated in the order need, timeline, budget, authority. Positive interest qualifies; negative disqualifies. BANT of medium or above (at least two matches) qualifies; low (one or no match) disqualifies. If BANT is empty only purchase interest is used.
Lead ratingHot / Warm / Cold from FIRE: Fit, Intent, Recency (up to 7 days recent, 8–21 moderate, over 21 old), Engagement; signals include timeline activity from the past 60 days and company research
  • Open a lead's summary banner → See full research for the Lead research page. Header: rating, auto-connected account and contact (matched by email; use Disconnect to correct), email validity and work/personal type, research timestamp. Suggested action: Research-only offers Draft email and Reassign; Research and engage adds Qualify. Key insights: What happened to this lead? (engage only), why it is hot, warm or cold, and How was this generated? (signal strength shows how complete and reliable the input data is; steps show the reasoning). Deeper insights: company overview, finances, up to three news items, custom research, competitor SWOT.
  • Disqualified leads are not handed over; they stay assigned to the agent and the supervisor can use Reassign to route them by the assignment rule. Invalid or missing email hands the lead back to the original seller.
  • Blocked (engage): the agent couldn't answer a lead's question; the lead goes to the seller who owned it.
  • Re-runs: first start processes qualifying leads in the look-back period; afterwards new leads in near real time. The full flow re-runs when the email changes from empty or invalid to valid, the account name changes from empty to valid, or an update makes the lead meet the criteria (related-table changes are checked hourly and only inside the look-back). A change from one email to another re-runs email validation only.
  • The error Insights couldn't be generated due to an error in a supporting process means a missing or invalid email or a missing account. The agent pauses when consent is revoked, capacity runs out, or the agent version is old.
Exam traps
  • Fit (High/Moderate/Low), rating (Hot/Warm/Cold) and purchase interest (high/medium/low intent) are three different scales.
  • In Research-only mode a Moderate-fit lead is handed over; only Low fit is disqualified.
  • Qualify appears only in engage mode; Reassign applies to disqualified leads in both.
  • Low signal strength means weak data, not necessarily a disinterested lead.

Monitor the Sales Qualification Agent

Supervisors and admins use App Settings → General settings → Dynamics 365 AI hub → AI optimization hub → See insights, then select Sales Qualification Agent, choose the Time period (default last 7 days) and Apply filters. Data refreshes when the dashboard opens; the Last refreshed time and a Refresh icon are shown. The View leads category list opens the leads disqualified, being processed or handed over by the agent. These views are visible to sellers too unless the environment setting EnableRoleBasedSystemViews is true.

ModeKey metrics
Research-onlyTotal leads researched; lead handling rate = (handed over + disqualified for low fit) / total processed; lead handoff rate = handed over / total processed; total disqualified. Lead processing funnel: assigned, in progress, disqualified, failed, handed over, opportunities created. Lead classification (Hot, Warm, Cold) and top accounts.
Research and engageLead handling rate (handed over with positive intent + disqualified for low interest); lead qualification rate (converted to customers); AI agent generated pipeline (estimated revenue of opportunities from handed-over leads); lead qualification time; research completion rate; email response rate; customer queries responded. Funnels add Blocked and a customer engagement funnel.
  • Manage: edit sections and select Apply changes (affects new leads; processed leads aren't reprocessed); Stop agent keeps the configuration and stops new leads being processed.
  • Capacity: the agent consumes Copilot Studio messages through prepaid capacity or pay-as-you-go; the Sales environment must be linked to a Power Platform environment; viewing existing insights costs nothing, simulation does; when quota is depleted the capability is unavailable until capacity is added (§2.2).
  • Custom roles need read on msdyn_salesagentrun, msdyn_salesagentprofile, msdyn_salesagenthandover, msdyn_engagereadinessagentresult and msdyn_synthesizeroutput to see the AI hub; custom apps add an AI hub site map entry.
  • Test first: use a sandbox with 3–4 sellers and one Sales Manager as supervisor, at least 10 leads that match the criteria and 5 that don't, a mix of high, medium and low fit, real company names and your own email addresses.
Exam traps
  • Handling rate counts leads the agent resolved on its own (handed over plus disqualified); handoff rate counts only handed-over leads.
  • Monitoring lives in the AI hub's AI optimization hub, not in sequence reporting or the capacity page.
  • Stopping the agent doesn't delete it and doesn't change its settings.
  • An agent that suddenly stops processing: check consent, capacity and agent version before changing criteria.

sections.title: 4.1 Optimize opportunity management
sections.html:
Skills measured: coordinate opportunity management with the Sales Close Agent • add Opportunity Products, and configure pricing • configure the opportunity pipeline view • set up and configure the Sales Opportunity Agent. Practise by adding catalog and write-in products under a price list, putting the Pipeline view on the Opportunity main form, and walking the 12 setup steps of the Sales Opportunity Agent for a small pilot segment.

Coordinate opportunity management with the Sales Close Agent

Status: Preview, being retiredThe Sales Close Agent is a production-ready Preview. The docs say that from September 30, 2026 you can't create new instances, that existing instances are removed on October 30, 2026, and that the replacement is the Sales Development agent (Preview, Microsoft Agent 365). It is still a skills-measured topic, so learn it as documented.
SituationUse
High-velocity, low-complexity deals: outreach, follow-up, objection handling and checkout, with a seller involved only when the buyer needs oneSales Close Agent (autonomous; Accounts, Contacts, Leads and Opportunities)
Open deals that sellers work themselves and that need research, stakeholder and competitor insight, and risk flagsSales Opportunity Agent (formerly Opportunity Research Agent), the last topic in this section
  • Scope the agent with Target customer (Guidance section). Pick the Record type: Contact, Account, Lead or Opportunity (the default). Add up to 10 conditions (rows, And/Or groups, related-entity conditions); the default opportunity condition is that the related Primary Contact's Email contains data. Preview lists the matching records.
  • Keep segments apart. The agent only considers records that aren't assigned to any other segment, so its conditions must not overlap those of other segments. The docs' example is unattended, lower-value opportunities.
  • Hand-offs. When a record needs a person (a complex objection or a specific request) the agent escalates it. Sellers and supervisors open Sales Hub → Sales → the entity → view selector → Opportunities from Sales Close Agent (similar views exist for Accounts, Contacts and Leads). They see only records they may access, and the Timeline shows what the agent did. Customers who aren't interested or stay silent are closed as lost; completed purchases are closed as complete (see §4.2).
  • Manual closing. Sellers close deals themselves with Close as Won or Close as Lost (all quotes must be Closed first); the details are stored as an Opportunity Close activity and the forecast category becomes Won or Lost. Reopen Opportunity in the Closed Opportunities view reopens a closed deal.
  • Change scope safely. Edit the settings, select Apply changes, and update the email content to match the new target segment. Records that were already processed aren't reprocessed.
  • Environment rules. Only one instance of the Close Agent type can be deployed in an environment, and the Sales Opportunity Agent type can sit in the same environment. A configured agent can't be deleted by an admin (contact Microsoft support). It consumes tenant Copilot Studio capacity, prepaid or pay-as-you-go.

Add Opportunity Products, and configure pricing

Seller steps (Sales Hub): Opportunities → open the opportunity → Products tab → pick a Price list (mandatory by default) → set Revenue → Add product → in Quick Create: Opportunity Product choose Existing or Write-In, then Price Overridden (Override Price lets you type your own price per unit), Quantity, Manual Discount Amount and Tax → Save & Create New or Save and Close. Products on the opportunity carry onto quotes generated from it.

RevenueBehaviour
System CalculatedEst. Revenue is calculated from the products; Est. Revenue and Total Amount update automatically only when System pricing calculation is on
User ProvidedYou enter a custom estimate; Est. Revenue is editable only when Revenue is User Provided and the opportunity is Open
  • Price list filter. With a price list selected, the Existing product lookup shows Products in Parent Price List (that default can't be changed) and a product that isn't on the list causes an error. With no price list it shows all active products.
  • Edit lines. Existing products allow inline quantity and discount changes; Write-in products also allow a price change, but use Write-in only for one-off items, never for standard products. Delete Opportunity Line removes a line.
  • Enhanced experience (admin switch; mobile keeps Quick Create): the Add products dialog adds free-text search, a product-family pane (Sales Hub), Recently used and Write in tabs and Save to opportunity. An admin must add the Price overridden column.

Product Catalog Settings: Sales Hub → Change area → App Settings → Product Catalog → Product Catalog Settings. A role needs Create on the Product table to create products, which are always organization-owned.

SettingEffect
Enhanced experience for adding productsTurns on the Add products dialog
Create product in active stateNew products without a parent family start Active; off = Draft
Allow selection of default pricelistSelects the territory's default price list on the opportunity
System pricing calculationOn = system pricing engine; off = custom pricing
Make price list optionalSellers can add products without a price list
Max number of products in a bundle / Max number of properties of a product or bundleDefaults 15 / 50; the property limit applies when you publish
Discount calculation methodLine item (default) or Per unit
Line item (default): (100 x 11) - 10 = 1,090
Per unit:            (100 - 10) x 11 = 990

Price lists (App Settings → Product Catalog → Price Lists) have a name, start and end date and a Currency; create at least one per currency. A price list item adds Product, Unit, Discount List, Quantity Selling Option and a Pricing Method: Currency Amount (you type the price), Percent of List, Percent Markup - Current Cost, Percent Markup - Standard Cost, Percent Margin - Current Cost or Percent Margin - Standard Cost. Methods other than Currency Amount can add a rounding policy (None, Up, Down, To Nearest). For territory defaults, add the territory on the price list's Territory Relationship tab with Add New Connection and turn on Allow selection of default pricelist.

Configure the opportunity pipeline view

The pipeline view (formerly the deal manager workspace) combines metrics, a bubble chart, a funnel chart, an editable grid and a side panel. The default opportunities view is the Read-only Grid view, so sellers choose Show As → Pipeline view unless you make it the default:

  1. In the sales app go to Settings → Advanced Settings → Customization → Customizations → Customize the System.
  2. Expand Tables → Opportunity → Forms, open the Main form and select Components.
  3. Search for Pipeline view (use Get more components if it is missing) and drag it onto the form.
  4. In Add pipeline view set Table = Opportunities, View = My Open Opportunities, Enable grouping = Yes and Enable aggregation = Yes (already on in monthly-channel or early-access environments), then select Done.
  5. Save and publish the form. In the classic designer use Entities → Opportunity → Controls tab → Pipeline view for web, phone and tablet.

Settings page: Sales Hub → Change area → App Settings → Opportunity pipeline view (General Settings). In the Sales Professional app append &pagetype=control&controlName=MscrmControls.Sales.DealManagerSettings.DealManagerSettings to the app URL. Access follows read privilege on the dealmanagersettings and dealmanageraccess tables, which customizable roles and the salesperson, sales manager and vice president of sales roles get by default.

SectionWhat you configure
Set the default form for side panelThe Sales Insights form is the default; choose the main form or a custom form. A seller's own choice is remembered
Set default metrics for sellersEdit metrics → Create a Metric: a numeric field, an aggregate function and optional filters (for example Est. Revenue, Sum, Created On = This year, Sales Stage = Develop)
Manage charts: Deal tracker (bubble)x-axis any DateTime field, y-axis any numeric field, Segment by (colour), Size, Sort legend, Tooltips
Manage charts: Sales funnelSegment by (default Pipeline phase), Values (default Est. revenue), Aggregation, Sort legend (for example Finish to start)
  • Each chart has a Status toggle that hides it. Save, then Publish.
  • Seller defaults: the bubble chart plots opportunity score (with Sales Insights, otherwise deal probability) against close date, sized by revenue and coloured by grade (otherwise pipeline phase). The funnel shows up to 50,000 records.
  • The grid is the Power Apps editable grid control, customized in Power Apps; old deal-manager JavaScript customizations must be redone. Unlike deal manager, access isn't limited to roles granted the workspace: all users who can open Opportunities can use the view.
  • Sellers can personalize columns, filters (And by default, Or through a group), layout (List or Combo) and side-panel mode and save a new view, but personalized metrics last only until sign-out.
  • Kanban is a different control: Opportunity and Activity tables, main grid only, not supported in the Dynamics 365 for Phones app, and tied to the Sales Process business process flow for opportunities.

Set up and configure the Sales Opportunity Agent

The Sales Opportunity Agent (previously the Opportunity Research Agent) researches open opportunities, flags risks and prioritizes them for sellers. The overview and setup pages carry no preview label; Connected skills is Preview. The docs call it a separate, distinct product from the Sales Close Agent.

Open it: Sales Hub → Change area → App Settings → General settings → Dynamics 365 AI hub → Agent manager → Create and manage agent → Create → Sales Opportunity Agent → Choose.

Prerequisites (the common agent prerequisites are in §2.2): admin permission in Sales, a Copilot Studio license, the modern UI for Sales Hub, and data policies that allow the Copilot Studio, public-website knowledge and Direct Line connectors (plus SharePoint/OneDrive and documents connectors when used). The agent's own Prerequisites section needs Bing search (Accept terms) and Dataverse Search (Set up opens the admin center Features page, where you enable the two search-indexing options; then Refresh). Microsoft 365 Services is optional but recommended: it reads seller email in place, sellers consent on first opening the Opportunity research page, and server-side synchronization works as an alternative. Salesperson and Sales Manager roles already have the permissions; a custom role needs user-level Read on the Connector table so sellers can consent.

The 12 setup steps, in order:

  1. Open the agent settings page.
  2. Requirements (the Prerequisites section above).
  3. Agent profile: name and language.
  4. Company info: your value proposition.
  5. Selection criteria (under General).
  6. Refresh frequency.
  7. Opportunity assessment: the monetary value field (for example Est. revenue) and the estimated close date field.
  8. Agent research: knowledge sources.
  9. Risk criteria.
  10. Importance criteria.
  11. Connected skills: the Recommended action toggle feeds the Recommended Actions agent.
  12. Start agent: enabled only when every section has a green check; accept the Bing Search and Move data across regions terms first.

Refresh frequency, Opportunity assessment, Risk criteria, Importance criteria and Connected skills are listed under Advanced.

SectionKey rules
Selection criteriaSegment name is only a label (no segmentation feature), plus filter conditions for open opportunities. Tick Consider opportunities created in the last and enter days to include older ones; otherwise only opportunities created after the agent is turned on count and Preview is empty. Daily refresh limit shows capacity
Refresh frequencyLow (recommended), Medium, High, Very low or Initial research only; the day counts differ between the settings page and the FAQ, so learn that High refreshes most often. Manage limits opens Copilot Studio for a message limit with Stop Usage
Agent researchPublic web by default. Add sources in Copilot Studio; files must be in a SharePoint folder, chosen through Featured → SharePoint, not Upload file (OneDrive isn't supported). Shared with the Sales Qualification Agent
Risk / Importance criteria11 default risks (for example Stalled in stage, Competitor mention, Missing BANT info) and 6 default importance criteria (for example Top 500 Account, Large deal size). Edit thresholds, add stage-specific thresholds, create a custom criterion (name, description, mapped fields) and use the Use in assessment toggle
  • Pilot first: pick a small segment (for example Hot, Est. revenue of $100,000 or more), tune to limit credit use, review risk settings, then widen. The predictive opportunity scoring model is configured automatically at start if it is missing.
  • Multiple instances: up to 10 active instances per organization, each with its own selection criteria. If criteria overlap, the instance with the earliest start time keeps the opportunity. All share one Copilot Studio knowledge base, filtered per instance by agent profile ID.
  • Editing: avoid editing after the agent starts, because results differ before and after the change. Knowledge-source, assessment-field and value-proposition changes apply at the next refresh; a selection-criteria change removes the research page of completed opportunities that no longer match.
Exam traps
  • Two agents, similar names. The Sales Close Agent emails customers on its own; the Sales Opportunity Agent (formerly Opportunity Research Agent) researches opportunities for sellers. The docs call them separate products.
  • Est. Revenue won't edit unless Revenue is User Provided and the opportunity is open; it recalculates by itself only with system pricing calculation on.
  • Discount method: the default Line item gives 1,090; Per unit gives 990 for the same 100 x 11 with a discount of 10.
  • The price list gates the product lookup. A product that isn't on the selected list errors; Make price list optional removes the requirement. Write-in isn't for standard products.
  • Publish the pipeline view after form and chart changes. Seller-personalized metrics vanish at sign-out, so use Set default metrics for sellers for shared KPIs.
  • Empty selection preview: without a look-back period the Opportunity Agent ignores opportunities created before it started. Knowledge files must come through Featured → SharePoint.

sections.title: 4.2 Automate deal closing by using the Sales Close Agent
sections.html:
Skills measured: set up and configure the Sales Close Agent • interpret the actions of the Sales Close Agent • monitor the Sales Close Agent • collaborate with the Sales Close Agent. Practise by running the manual setup in a sandbox, using the Test step, and then reading the agent insights dashboard and the All Sales Agent Runs view.

Status: Preview, being retiredThe Sales Close Agent is a production-ready Preview. The docs say that from September 30, 2026 you can't create new instances, that existing instances are removed on October 30, 2026, and that you should create a Sales Development agent (Preview) instead. The chat-based AI setup assistant (Preview) isn't available after June 2026; manual setup remains fully supported. Some pages call the agent the Engage type or Engage mode. The exam still lists the skill, so learn it as documented.

Set up and configure the Sales Close Agent

Prerequisites. Finish the common agent prerequisites (§2.2), then confirm admin permissions in Sales, a Copilot Studio license, the modern UI for the Sales Hub app, and in-app notifications (they announce handovers to sellers and supervisors). Data policies must allow Knowledge source with public websites and data, Microsoft Copilot Studio, Microsoft Dataverse and Direct Line channels in Copilot Studio, plus the SharePoint or OneDrive and documents knowledge-source connectors if you use them. Turning on Copilot in Dynamics 365 Sales is optional but recommended. The agent's Prerequisites section has four tasks, each ended by ticking Mark as done, which you must do to proceed:

TaskWho and whereKey point
Create app in AzureEntra Application DeveloperRegister an application and copy the Application (client) ID
Create an app user in DataverseSystem Administrator; admin center → Settings → Users + permissions → Application usersAdd the app, set the root business unit and the security role AIsalesperson
Create a shared mailboxGlobal, Exchange or Exchange Recipient administrator; Exchange admin center → Recipients → MailboxesAdd a shared mailbox with a display name and email address
Configure server-side synchronizationSystem Administrator plus Global or Exchange administratorOn the app user's mailbox use the shared mailbox address, Approve Email, then Test & Enable Mailbox

Without server-side synchronization the agent doesn't generate outreach emails or engage with customers.

Manual setup order: open the settings (Sales Hub → Change area → App Settings → General settings → Dynamics 365 AI hub → Agent manager → Create and manage agent → Create → Sales Close Agent → Choose → Manual setup), then:

#SectionKey facts
1Agent profile (General)Name, description, Agent user (the app user that owns records and sends email), Email signature (the mailbox name must match the agent name in the signature), AI disclaimer (tells recipients an AI agent wrote the email; agree the wording with legal), Other terms
2Products (General)Up to 10 products. Price comes from the Amount on the product's Default Price List, the link from ProductURL. No dynamic discounting, bundles or complex pricing. Add a value proposition, up to three search fields (the agent matches on any one) and a customer-friendly name field; Quick create product record and Add missing info fill gaps
3Target customer (Guidance)Record type and up to 10 conditions (§4.1)
4Email delivery (Guidance)Compliance profile, purpose and topic; a default profile exists, Manage compliance settings creates another. Outreach goes only to leads and contacts who gave consent
5Email content (Guidance)Outreach email templates (choose or create; variables personalize) and Tone for emails prompts. Up to 10,000 emails a day (Exchange Online limit); extra emails queue to the next day
6Knowledge sources (Knowledge)See the next list
7TestSimulates agent and customer exchanges without touching real CRM data
8Start agentEnabled only when every section has a green check; status becomes On; the first outreach can take up to 20 minutes; email engagement tracking (opens, link clicks) is on by default
  • Agent playbook: an Excel file of intent groups, intents and agent instructions (a default playbook is supplied). Its sensitivity label must be General or Public. You can't edit it after upload: download, change, upload the new file, delete the old one, and wait for Ready before publishing.
  • Product documentation: a SharePoint folder added through folder sync; Copilot Studio refreshes synced folders every four hours. Product catalog: the Dataverse Product table, set up by default; add synonyms and glossary terms for purchase-URL columns. Publish after knowledge changes.
  • Environment rules: one Close Agent instance per environment, which can't be deleted once configured (contact Microsoft support). After publishing, avoid editing sections tagged Avoid edits.
  • Migrate to production: export one solution per agent profile (the profile, its configuration and the agents that hold the knowledge sources) as managed and import it; the agent always arrives in draft. The Dataverse application user, app registrations and prerequisites aren't in the solution, so recreate them in the target, select the application user in the agent profile, review the selection criteria (organization-agnostic filters travel best), verify the knowledge sources, select Apply changes (make a minor description edit if it is disabled) and start the agent.

Interpret the actions of the Sales Close Agent

StepWhat the agent does
1 Record selectionPicks records that match the target customer criteria
2 Personalized outreachBuilds personalized messages from the templates in Email content
3 Initial customer engagementSends the outreach email, monitors replies, recommends products and addresses objections from the knowledge sources
4 Follow-up automationFollows up on triggers such as customer responses or a change in deal status
5 Transaction closureGuides the customer to self-service checkout and closes the record as complete
  • Escalation: at any step the agent hands the record to a human seller when it needs intervention, for example a complex objection or a specific customer request.
  • Rate and retries: it processes up to 20 emails within 10 minutes (to protect AI credits). After an error it retries up to three times within the next hour with exponential backoff, then over the next three days, and then marks the engagement as a failure.
  • Follow-ups: no reply to the first email means up to four follow-up emails over the next three weeks; the schedule isn't configurable (ask Microsoft support). Customers who aren't interested, or never reply, are closed as lost. Questions and objections are answered from the knowledge sources.
  • Run status of one record: open <crm_org_url>/main.aspx?pagetype=entitylist&etn=msdyn_salesagentrun, use the All Sales Agent Runs view and filter Regarding. Status is Active (pending), Failure or Completed.
  • Record form (the entity from Sales Close Agent views for Accounts, Contacts, Leads and Opportunities): Key insights summarizes the agent's actions; Review escalated issue offers Send email or Action not relevant; What has happened to this contact summarizes the engagement; the activity email sits at the bottom. Records still being processed don't appear until processing completes.

Monitor the Sales Close Agent

Open the dashboard: Sales Hub → App settings → General settings → Dynamics 365 AI hub (it needs access permission) → AI Optimization card → See insights → Sales Close Agent tab. Data refreshes when you open the page (check Last refreshed, or select the Refresh icon), and the Time period filter defaults to the last 7 days.

SectionMetric and meaning
Top metricsTotal number of records: records that received an outreach email. Engagements rate: records where the agent engaged the customer or handed the record to a seller. Customers pitched by agent: customers given a product recommendation
Agent effectivenessAverage attempts to achieve engagement: outreach emails sent before a reply. Autonomous resolution rate: records completed without human involvement. Escalation rate: records handed to a supervisor
Engagement funnelOutreach email sent, Customer responded, Customer not responded, Engaged, Products pitch, Escalated, Completed, Closed as lost
  • Per-record monitoring: the entity from Sales Close Agent views and the All Sales Agent Runs view (Failure shows the engagements that need attention).
  • Capacity: the agent uses tenant Copilot Studio capacity, prepaid or pay-as-you-go. Both need the Sales environment linked to a Power Platform environment, and prepaid is consumed first. View usage in the Power Platform admin center (Summary tab). Low or depleted quota triggers in-app notifications; when it is depleted the AI capability is unavailable until you allocate more prepaid capacity or raise the pay-as-you-go budget in Microsoft Cost Management.
  • Run state: Edit, change sections, then Apply changes (enabled only when every section is green); new records follow the new settings and processed records aren't reprocessed. Stop agent keeps the configuration and the processed records. If the agent can't start, contact Microsoft support.

Collaborate with the Sales Close Agent

  1. The agent escalates a record; sellers and supervisors learn about it through in-app notifications (a prerequisite) and the entity from Sales Close Agent view.
  2. Open the record, read What has happened to this contact and the email activity, and check the Timeline.
  3. In Review escalated issue select Send email to continue the conversation yourself, or Action not relevant if the insight doesn't apply.
Situation with custom security rolesDo this
Everyone who has the custom role should work contacts the agent hands overGrant the permissions below to the custom role
Only a subset of users should work themAssign the out-of-the-box Salesperson or Sales Manager role only to those users
TableAccess
Email Activity (email)User level: Read, Write, Create, Append, Append To
Contact (contact)User level: Read, Append, Append To
Sales Agent Profile, Sales Agent Run, Sales Agent Configuration v2Global level: Read
SCA Engage Agent Result (msdyn_dcaengageagentresult)Basic level: Read, Write
  • Transparency: every email carries the signature and the AI disclaimer from the agent profile, and outreach respects the consent in the compliance profile. Users see only records they have permission to access.
  • Coordination: keep the target segment distinct from other segments (§4.1) and update the email content whenever the target criteria change. Copilot in Dynamics 365 Sales gives sellers a 360-degree view of the record (optional).
Exam traps
  • Server-side synchronization is a hard prerequisite. If it isn't set up, the agent doesn't generate outreach emails or engage with customers; Mark as done is just a checkbox you must select to proceed with the configuration.
  • Playbook label: a Confidential (or higher) label can stop the agent reading the playbook; use General or Public. An uploaded playbook can't be edited in place.
  • Products are base-price only: at most 10, price from the default price list, no dynamic discounts or bundles.
  • Failure is not a lost deal. Failure means the engagement still failed after the retries; a customer who declines or stays silent after the follow-ups is closed as lost.
  • Three similar KPIs: Autonomous resolution rate (completed without humans), Escalation rate (handed to a supervisor), Engagements rate (engaged or handed to a seller).
  • Custom roles: granting the permissions to the shared custom role opens agent-handed-over contacts to every user in that role; to limit them, assign the Salesperson or Sales Manager role to just those users. AIsalesperson is the agent's own app-user role, not a seller role.

sections.title: 4.3 Gather intelligence on sales deals by using the Sales Research Agent
sections.html:
Skills measured: evaluate use cases for the Sales Research Agent • configure the Sales Research Agent • analyze sales performance by using research canvas. Practise by giving a test user the reader role, generating a blueprint from a suggested topic, uploading a small CSV, and then changing one chart with Update block.

StatusThe overview, setup and usage pages of the Sales Research Agent show no Preview label; the 2025 wave 2 release plan (now archived) listed general availability for March 2026. Business Function Builder is Preview. Some link texts elsewhere still say "(preview)" for the agent, so rely on the page content.

Evaluate use cases for the Sales Research Agent

The Sales Research Agent is an AI-based research canvas in the Sales Hub app. A sales leader asks a question in natural language and gets a blueprint: a summary, key findings, suggested next steps and charts. The user steers it as a dialog (follow-up questions, other chart types, extra data), whereas the Sales Qualification, Opportunity and Close agents are described as working autonomously. Documented uses are research, analysis and recommendations for pipeline exploration, sales operations and what-if analysis, for a specific question ("What is our average win rate this year?") or an open prompt ("Tell me about our pipeline coverage").

  • Data sources: Dynamics 365 Sales data (default), other Dataverse environments you can access, Microsoft Fabric Lakehouse, and uploaded CSV, Excel or PDF files. You can remove the default connection and research uploaded files only. Answers use only data the signed-in user is allowed to see.
  • Out-of-box business functions: Pipeline Exploration (selected by default) and Sales Operation. The same data can yield different blueprints under different functions.
ScenarioUse
A sales leader explores coverage, win rate or what-if questions across many records, possibly with quota files from Fabric or an uploadSales Research Agent
Opportunities need autonomous research, emerging risks flagged and promising opportunities highlightedSales Opportunity Agent (§4.1)
Leads must be researched, qualified and contactedSales Qualification Agent (§3.2)
Sellers need prioritized next tasks for their opportunitiesRecommended Actions Agent
Customers are engaged autonomously to close dealsSales Close Agent (§4.2; since September 30, 2026 new instances can't be created and existing instances will be removed on October 30, 2026)
Exam traps
  • The Research Agent answers questions across your data on demand. Per-opportunity research and risks belong to the Sales Opportunity Agent, and lead work to the Sales Qualification Agent.
  • Fabric Lakehouse and uploaded files are data sources for the Research Agent, not separate agents.
  • Security still applies: the agent reads only what the user may access, and the docs say it isn't designed for social scoring.

Configure the Sales Research Agent

TaskKey facts
CapacityThe agent needs Copilot Studio capacity: the environment you use it from must have enough Copilot credits. Without credits, or when throttled, users can't generate or interact with a blueprint.
AccessThe Sales Research Agent menu in Sales Hub is visible by default only to System Administrator and System Customizer. Assign the Sales Research Agent Reader role to other users in the Power Platform admin center, or assign it to a group team that contains them. Users also need a Dynamics 365 Sales license, and the tenant must be in a supported region.
Tenant settingsThe agent follows Copilot feedback (off, thumbs up or down only, or detailed feedback) and Bing search consent. On: it may query Bing using only the user's prompt. Off: it uses internal data only, such as uploads and Dynamics 365 data.
General contextMy Work → Sales Research Agent → Manage your context → Your general context: role, industry, fiscal year, currency and Acronyms and data dictionary. A fiscal-year start lets the agent map "Q1" correctly. Delete all clears it.
Business functionOptional: try the agent without one first, and create one for custom fields or logic, more control over interpretation, or your own business knowledge for a use case. Business Function Builder Preview: Manage business functions → describe the use case → review the discovered anchor tables → answer clarification questions → generate and review the draft → save. Validate with the built-in evaluation (test questions, pass rates), then Share it (More commands) with a team, a security role or a business unit.
Data sourcesAdd data in the Ask any business question box. Give custom tables and fields descriptions; if they're missing, add data instructions to a business function. Follow-ups reuse the same source unless you name another. Currency comes from the connected environment's base currency, or is inferred or taken from your context for Lakehouse and uploads.
Uploaded fileLimits
All files10 MB per file; at most 5 files and 30 MB in total; encrypted, password-protected or copyright-managed files aren't supported
CSVValues separated by commas
ExcelHeader in the first row only; up to 10 tables and 50 columns per table; no merged cells; images, charts and macros can't be processed
PDFUp to 150 pages; selectable text (a scanned PDF doesn't work); clearly outlined table borders

Fabric Lakehouse. The agent signs in to Fabric with the user's Dynamics 365 (Microsoft Entra ID) identity and inherits that user's permissions: Viewer, Contributor or Admin on the workspace, access to the Lakehouse item, read access to a shortcut's target, Purview policies, and row-level or column-level security exposed through semantic models. It reads Lakehouse Tables (Delta Lake or Parquet) and shortcuts with read-only generated queries. No Lakehouse option means Fabric isn't enabled, the user has no workspace access, or an admin restricted Fabric access.

Exam traps
  • System Customizer sees the menu by default, but the intended way to open it to managers is Sales Research Agent Reader, directly or through a group team.
  • Limits to memorize: 10 MB per file, 5 files, 30 MB total, PDFs up to 150 pages with selectable text, Excel with no merged cells and the header in row 1.
  • Bing search consent and feedback are tenant settings in the admin center. With Bing consent off, the agent works from internal data sources only.
  • Missing credits and unsupported regions also block access; a role alone doesn't fix them.
  • Business Function Builder is Preview and optional; custom fields without descriptions need data instructions.

Analyze sales performance by using research canvas

  1. In the Sales Hub site map, go to My Work → Sales Research Agent. If the page stays blank, allow third-party cookies for it.
  2. (Optional) Pick a business function; Pipeline Exploration is selected by default.
  3. Select a suggested research topic, or type a question in Ask any business question, optionally use Add data, and select Generate. The agent builds a blueprint.
Canvas partWhat it does
WorkspaceShows the workspace name (rename it with the pencil icon); the hamburger icon switches or creates workspaces
DataShows the data source; Add data adds more
Journey linesThe questions you asked during the research
AI cursorLets you click a visualization to change it, add data or ask a question
BlueprintFindings in the left pane and interactive visuals; Show work reveals the research plan, data sources, analysis and visualizations behind them
GoalAction
Change only one chart or blockActivate the AI cursor (hover over the blueprint and select its icon, or press Alt+C), ask, then Generate → Update block
Explore a follow-up and keep the current blueprintGenerate → Generate new blueprint (adds a journey line). Pressing Enter in the prompt also generates a new blueprint
Get the latest data or new visuals and insightsRefresh icon at the top right of the blueprint
Add a file for a follow-up+ icon (CSV, PDF or Excel)
Rate the resultThumbs up or down at the top of each blueprint
Exam traps
  • Enter creates a new blueprint. To change one block, select Generate and then Update block.
  • The Refresh icon refreshes or regenerates the whole blueprint; it isn't a way to edit one chart.
  • Show work explains how conclusions were reached; Journey lines record the questions asked.
  • The default function is Pipeline Exploration; choosing another function changes the blueprint without changing the data.

Sources: Sales Research Agent overview · AI agents in Dynamics 365 Sales · Set up and configure · Connect data · Fabric Lakehouse · Provide context · Business Function Builder · Share business functions · Analyze sales performance · FAQ · Responsible AI FAQ

sections.title: 5.1 Configure supporting apps and services
sections.html:
Skills measured: deploy and configure the Sales mobile app • set up Teams calling • configure an SMS channel. Practise by installing the app on a phone, enabling the Teams dialer for a pilot role, and connecting a trial SMS provider in a sandbox environment.

StatusThe Sales Hub Dialer (Preview) was deprecated and removed from all environments in July 2026; the docs name the Microsoft Teams dialer as the alternative. In the Teams dialer, Transfer calls and Add people to calls are Preview. The Azure Communication Services free-trial "Azure SMS preview" is documented as temporarily unavailable.

Deploy and configure the Sales mobile app

The Dynamics 365 Sales mobile app helps field sellers plan the day, add notes and contacts after meetings, and find records. Sellers install it from the Apple App Store or Google Play (search Dynamics 365 Sales). It doesn't work in China, the Government/Sovereign cloud or Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement (on-premises).

PrerequisiteDetail
RecommendedRelevance search enabled for the environment; Exchange Online
Set a regarding record on a meetingServer-side synchronization enabled and the mailbox email address approved
User permissionsRead on the Organization table, Read on the Mailbox table, and the Dynamics 365 for mobile privilege

Set the privilege under Settings → Security → Security Roles → the role → Business Management tab → Privacy Related Privileges → Dynamics 365 for mobile = Organization. It is preconfigured for Sales roles only. Without it, users see an empty app list or "Contact your administrator for access your organization's mobile apps".

CapabilitySales mobile appDynamics 365 for phones and tablets
What it isDesigned for core sales scenarios; supports model-driven configurationLegacy app that opens Sales Hub or Sales Professional
DevicesiOS and Android phones; tablets get the Unified InterfacePhones and tablets
OfflinePartial (mobile offline profile)Yes
Online meetings, Teams join, Exchange calendar, server-side syncSupportedNot supported
Push notifications, lightweight record and activity formsSupportedNot supported
  • Forms: the app shows quick view forms. If a table has several, it uses the first in the form order, so reorder them or edit the first one. Changes can take up to six hours to appear. For Unified Interface forms, open the Power Platform admin center → Environments → your environment → Settings → Product → Features, and in the Dynamics 365 Sales mobile app section turn on as needed:
    • Create new records and activities using Unified Interface forms instead of quick view forms
    • Disable the option to quick create new records and activities in the Mobile application (available only when the create setting above is on)
    • Edit and view records and activities using Unified Interface forms instead of quick view forms
  • Quick create: a table or activity needs Allow quick create and Enable for phone express (IsQuickCreateEnabled and IsVisibleInMobile become true) plus a quick view form. The form shows the main quick view form's fields plus ApplicationRequired fields.
  • Push notifications: in Power Automate use Send push notification V2 with Mobile app = Sales, your app, a recipient (email or Microsoft Entra object ID), a message, Open app = Yes, Entity and Record ID. Without a record ID the notification opens the home screen; with one it opens that record.
  • Intune: add the iOS and Android store apps to Intune → assign them to users and devices (managed or not) → create and assign app protection policies (MAM without enrollment covers BYOD) → users work in the managed app, where copy and paste can be restricted.
Exam traps
  • The Sales mobile app is not Dynamics 365 for phones and tablets; only the Sales app has push notifications, Teams meeting join, Exchange calendar and server-side sync.
  • An empty app list after sign-in points to the missing Dynamics 365 for mobile privilege, not to Intune or licensing.
  • With several quick view forms only the first in form order is used, and edits take up to six hours to show.

Set up Teams calling

The Microsoft Teams dialer brings Teams calling into Sales Hub, so sellers make and receive calls without leaving the app. Each call creates a phone call activity.

PrerequisiteDetail
Licensing and telephonyA Teams license; a phone system that is installed, configured and licensed; a valid PSTN connection (Teams calling plan, your own carrier or direct routing); an assigned phone number
Security rolesUsers' roles need Read on Note (Core Records tab) and Teams Dialer Admin settings (Custom Entities tab); users must hold the roles you enable
Side effectOther telephony connected through Channel Integration Framework stops working for users who get the dialer; deactivate or delete that phone system in the Channel Integration Framework app

Configure: Sales Hub → App settings → General settings → Teams calls.

  1. Turn on Teams calls. Options: Answer incoming calls in Dynamics 365 (off = outgoing only); Internal call will ring only in the Teams app, not in Dynamics 365 (internal calls aren't tracked); Display missed calls in the Dynamics 365 in-app notification center (needs in-app notifications and Read on Notification); Call from views (phone links in list views); Document call attempts (logs unanswered calls in the activity history).
  2. In Security role choose All security roles or Specific security roles. Selected roles must be associated with the root business unit, or users won't see the dialer.
  3. Under Advanced options → Select app pick the apps (Sales Hub by default; canvas apps aren't supported).
  4. Optional: turn on Recording with real-time transcription and insights, select its roles, and use Go to advanced conversation intelligence settings for more.
  5. Save and publish, refresh the configuration page, and have users refresh theirs. If the dialer is missing from a custom app, remove it from the app, save, and add it again.
  • Sales Professional app: open the settings page by appending pagetype=control&controlName=MscrmControls.TeamsDialerSettings.DialerSettingsHostControl to the org URL, or add the page as a site map subarea.
  • Quick setup: Sales settings → Conversation intelligence → Quick setup → turn on Teams calls (answer-incoming and internal-call options, Enable for all or specific roles) → optionally turn on recording with its own roles → Update. A Sales Enterprise license includes unlimited conversation intelligence and Teams calling hours. Turning Teams calls off also turns recording off; recording can be turned off alone.
  • Seller experience: the phone icon at the top right opens the Calls pane (allow third-party cookies). Sellers call from a record's phone field, a list view, the Sales accelerator work list or Up next widget, or manually, and pick the conversation language for accurate transcription. An inbound call shows the caller's name when the number matches a record (up to 3 records listed).
Exam traps
  • Pilot roles that aren't associated with the root business unit hide the dialer even when everything else is right.
  • Enabling the dialer stops Channel Integration Framework telephony for those users.
  • The dialer doesn't work on custom entities (the phone icon still shows) or in canvas apps.

Configure an SMS channel

Supported providers are Azure Communication Services (ACS), Infobip, LINK Mobility, Telesign, Twilio and Vibes (Vibes: US and Canada only). The integration works in any country where you can buy a number from the provider. For another provider, build a custom SMS channel. Text messaging works only in web browsers.

Steps: sign in to the sales app → Change area → App Settings → SMS providers → New → select the provider (first time only: accept the Microsoft privacy statement and the provider's consent to handle opt-out commands) → Next → enter the provider values on Set up provider → Next → New phone number → Add → Next → Review and finish → Done.

ProviderValues you enterWhere the callback URLs go
ACSPrimary and secondary connection strings (Keys)Delivery report URL into the delivered subscription webhook; incoming URL into the received subscription webhook
InfobipAPI Base URL, API keyIncoming URL sent to Infobip customer support
LINK MobilityPlatform ID, Platform Partner ID, Gate ID, username, password, Base URLDelivery report and incoming URLs sent to LINK Mobility support
TelesignCustomer SID, API keyTurn on Status Callback; incoming URL sent to Telesign support
TwilioAccount SID, Auth tokenIncoming URL pasted into the number's A MESSAGE COMES IN field
VibesUsername, passwordAn incoming URL is generated; no destination is documented
  • Phone number pane: <country_code><phone_number> such as +12345678910 with no spaces or special characters, unique to Dynamics 365 Sales (don't reuse numbers set up for other Dynamics 365 apps); a unique Name; the Owner users or teams (only they can use the number); optional Type (Geo, Short code, Toll free). To change owners later: SMS providers → the provider → Phone numbers tab → View additional properties → Owner → Update.
  • Availability: APAC, Canada, Europe, France, Great Britain, India, Japan, North America, Oceania, South America, Switzerland and UAE. Not in the Germany, China, South Africa, Korea or Norway datacenters, nor in GCC (including USG and DoD).
  • Permissions: no extra privileges if Sales accelerator is enabled for the roles; otherwise sellers need privileges such as Channel Instance, SalesOmnichannel Message, Text message template, Transcript and Notification, and managers or sequence managers also need Read, Write and Assign on the Twilio and Telesign channel instances. In-app notifications must be on to see replies.
  • Reply routing: a reply attaches to the record with the most recent conversation, then the record owned by the addressed seller, then one owned by a seller on the team that owns the number, then by type (Contact, Account, Opportunity, Lead), active before inactive, most recently updated. Keep the number in mobilephone, telephone1 or telephone2; any other field creates a new lead.
  • Custom SMS channel: six steps (channel-instance extension, channel-instance-account extension, message parts, optional admin localization, custom APIs, channel definition) built on msdyn_channeldefinition, msdyn_channelmessagepart, msdyn_channellocale, msdyn_channelinstanceaccount and msdyn_channelinstance. Message parts must hold a single part with msdyn_name = text.
Exam traps
  • Reply setup differs per provider: Twilio uses A MESSAGE COMES IN, ACS uses event webhooks, and Infobip, LINK Mobility and Telesign need the URL sent to their support teams.
  • Credentials are provider-specific: Account SID and Auth token are Twilio, connection strings are ACS, Customer SID is Telesign.
  • Replies from numbers stored outside mobilephone, telephone1 and telephone2 create a new lead.
  • Vibes is US and Canada only, and the feature isn't available in the Germany datacenter or in GCC.

sections.title: 5.2 Expand the sales footprint by using Microsoft Power Platform
sections.html:
Skills measured: create Power Automate flows • embed Power Apps components and controls • embed Power BI reports. Practise by building one flow for each Dataverse trigger, embedding a canvas app in a form, adding the Kanban control to an Opportunity view, and showing a Power BI report on a form and in a system dashboard.

Create Power Automate flows

NeedUse
Act when sales data changes (for example, email the manager when an opportunity's Est. Revenue is updated)Automated cloud flow, Dataverse trigger When a row is added, modified or deleted
Sellers pick rows in a view and run the flow from the command barInstant (manual) cloud flow, When a row is selected; it can also run as a business process flow step
React when a Dataverse custom action runsWhen an action is performed (inputs: Catalog, Category, Table name, Action name)
Weekly pipeline digest, or a button tap in Power Automate or the mobile appScheduled flow (Recurrence), or instant flow (Manually trigger a flow)
  • Row added, modified or deleted: set Change type, Table name and Scope (Business Unit, Organization, Parent: Child business unit, User). The maker needs user-level create, read, write and delete on Callback Registration; 1:N and N:N relationships aren't supported. Select columns (Update only; scalar columns, no lookups) fires when a listed column is in the request, even if its value is unchanged. Filter rows takes an OData expression such as firstname eq 'John', evaluated after the save. Run as (Flow owner, Row owner, Modifying user) needs the Act on Behalf of Another User privilege, which the Delegate role includes.
  • Row selected: build it in Power Automate or from the app's Flow menu, then add users or groups under Run only users on the flow's details page. Split on is required (on by default): one run per selected row. Users see only a "started" confirmation, run-only users can't see run history, and more than 40 selected rows may cause an error.
  • Solution-aware flows: create the flow inside a solution (needs Dataverse and environment version 9.1.0.267 or later) so it moves between environments with the solution.
  • Custom insight card: Sales Hub, Change area, Sales Insights settings, Assistant, Home (Assistant Studio), + New insight card, + Create from blank. The flow's Dynamics 365 Sales Insights action Create card for assistant takes Card name, Card header, Card text and a Primary action type (Custom action (CRM process), Open record, Open URL, REST). Clear all Flow Checker errors and warnings to save.
Exam traps
  • Select columns is not a "value changed" test, so don't expect it to ignore unchanged values.
  • Row selected never batches the selection into one run, and users get no result message unless the flow sends one (add an email or Teams action).
  • On a team-owned row, Run as Row owner falls back to the flow owner.
  • A business process flow is the stage bar on a record, not a cloud flow, and a Dataverse action is not a Power Automate action.
  • Templates for creating new assistant cards are no longer available Removed; existing cards keep working, and custom cards come from a flow and appear in Assistant Studio only after the first card is generated.

Embed Power Apps components and controls

GoalUseHow
Add a subgrid, quick view, web resource or pen input to a formForm designer componentComponents pane (or + Component under a selected column). Show component on: Web, Mobile, Tablet, all selected by default. Save, then Publish.
Show a column as a slider, or a view as a different gridCode component (Power Apps component framework)Customize the System, the form column (or the table), Controls tab, Add Control, choose Web, Phone or Tablet. Hide Default Control removes the original control.
Show data from other sources, such as SharePoint, beside Dataverse dataEmbedded canvas appSolutions, table, Forms, Main, Components, Display, Canvas app; set App name and App ID; Save and publish.
Board of opportunities or activitiesKanban controlCustomize the System, Opportunity or Activity table, Views, a public view, Components, Add Component, Kanban (if missing: Get more components, Built by Microsoft). Save, then publish.
Predictive score on an opportunity formOpportunity scoring widgetForm designer: Component, Layout, 1-Column section, then Display, Predictive score.
  • App name is the canvas app's unique name (publisherprefix_name_suffix, shown in the solution); App ID is on the app's Details page. Both are required; the control tries the unique name first, then the ID, and the app must be in the same environment.
  • Both form designers can add an existing canvas app. Only the classic designer (Switch to classic, add a required column, Controls tab, Add Control, Canvas app, Web) can create one, and an app that reads form data through ModelDrivenFormIntegration must be created there. Custom pages are the newer route.
  • Rules: Unified Interface only; at most three embedded canvas apps enabled with the Web client type per form; bind to a required column that always has a value; nothing shows on a new unsaved row. ModelDrivenFormIntegration.Item is read-only, so write back with the Dataverse connector (the form's Save doesn't save the app).
  • Share: share the app with a security group or named users and give the role Read on the Canvas App table. The pipeline view control is covered in §4.1.
Exam traps
  • Publishing the form does not publish the embedded canvas app; publish the app separately.
  • The Canvas App privilege in a security role does not share the app: users keep seeing "It looks like you don't have access to this app" until it is shared. Everyone isn't supported in Dataverse; use a security group or named users.
  • Kanban limits: Opportunity and Activity main grid only (no subgrids, no Dynamics 365 for Phones); card fields can't be changed; Activity Kanban works only on Status; Opportunity Kanban works only with the Sales Process business process flow, with aggregation only on Est. Revenue.
  • The scoring widget needs Unified Interface and can't be added in the legacy form designer.

Embed Power BI reports

NeedMethodKey points
Same report for all users in the app's Dashboards list, packaged in a solutionPower BI embedded system dashboardmake.powerapps.com, Solutions, New, Dashboard, Power BI embedded; choose Power BI report or Power BI dashboard and a workspace (clear Show reports in this environment only for other workspaces). Turn on Use environment variable when each environment has its own workspace. Add it to the app: Add page, Dashboard, System dashboards picker, Power BI dashboards; save and publish.
Report on a form, filtered to the current rowControl in the main form XMLExport an unmanaged dev solution, replace a placeholder subgrid's control in customizations.xml, import it back.
A user's own visualsPersonal dashboardDashboards, New, Power BI Dashboard, or Power BI Tile on a personal dashboard; needs embedding enabled, a Power BI account and third-party cookies. Share in both Dataverse and Power BI.
Quick report on the current viewVisualize this viewAdmin turns on Enable Power BI quick report visualization on a table; Power BI Pro to edit or publish; not for Activities or guest users.
<control id="filteredreport" classid="{8C54228C-1B25-4909-A12A-F2B968BB0D62}">
  <parameters>
    <PowerBIGroupId>00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000</PowerBIGroupId>
    <PowerBIReportId>544c4162-6773-4944-900c-abfd075f6081</PowerBIReportId>
    <TileUrl>https://app.powerbi.com/reportEmbed?reportId=544c4162-6773-4944-900c-abfd075f6081</TileUrl>
    <PowerBIFilter>{"Filter": "...", "Alias": {"$a": "form_table_attribute"}}</PowerBIFilter>
  </parameters>
</control>
  • Enable embedding: Power Platform admin center, Manage, Environments, the environment, Settings, Product, Features, Embedded content, Power BI visualization embedding = On (default off). It is required for personal dashboards and tiles. For system dashboards and forms the pages disagree (the dashboard article says the setting is ignored; the form article lists it as a prerequisite), so turn it on if embedding fails.
  • Security: users need a Power BI license and access to the content, and sign in to Power BI with their Power Apps identity (no matching account shows a sign-in prompt). Cross-tenant embedding isn't supported.
  • Filter rules: PowerBIFilter aliases map to attributes of the form's table; data types must match and string values need escaped quotes. A tile on a form can't be filtered, and pinned dashboard tiles aren't interactive. If the form stays blank after import, open and save it in the designer.
  • Retired: the Sales Analytics and Process Analytics template apps Deprecated are no longer downloadable; sales usage reports are also deprecated, with a sample Power BI report as the alternative.
Exam traps
  • Power Apps (Dynamics 365) security roles and privileges do not affect the data an embedded report shows; restrict it with Power BI row-level security (RLS).
  • A personal dashboard is built and shared by individual users; for every user in the Dashboards list, create a system dashboard.
  • The form embed is finished in solution XML (control class ID {8C54228C-1B25-4909-A12A-F2B968BB0D62}) rather than in the form designer, which shows nothing meaningful for it.

sections.title: Study habits that work
sections.html:
• Build, then read. Do the task in the product first, then read the section to see what you missed.
  • Memorize exact names: menu paths, settings, limits, roles and (for code) object, method and attribute names.
  • Practise the decision, not just the definition. For every feature write "choose it when / do not choose it when".
  • Keep a trap log. Every missed question becomes one line: what I picked and why it was wrong.
  • Use the Missed filter in Quick drill until it is empty, then re-take the full exam.
  • Read documentation dated 2026. Features were renamed and moved between preview and GA recently.

sections.title: Exam-day plan
sections.html:
The week before

  • Take the full timed practice exam twice, a few days apart; fix every skill rated below 4.
  • Skim the cheat sheets and your trap log — do not start new topics.
  • Run the exam sandbox (aka.ms/examdemo) once so flagging, the review screen and the case-study layout are familiar.
  • Online exam? Run Pearson VUE's system test, clear your desk and room and have government ID ready. Test center? Confirm the address and arrival time.
  • Re-check the official study guide in case Microsoft revised the skills list.

During the exam

TopicApproach
PacingWith 40–60 questions in 120 minutes you have roughly 2.0–3.0 minutes per question. Do not spend more than about 3 minutes on one item in the first pass.
First passAnswer what you know, flag what you do not. Answer every question before time runs out — an unanswered item cannot earn credit.
EliminationCross out answers that use retired, renamed or wrong-direction features. Many questions have two plausible options — look for the deciding constraint (GA versus Preview, required role, prerequisite, order of steps).
Multi-selectCount how many answers are requested ("Select TWO"); each must be independently correct.
Configuration itemsCheck the exact setting, scope, role or sequence the requirement names before choosing between similar options.
Case studiesSkim the questions first, then read the scenario for the requirements and constraints that matter. Re-read the exhibit instead of relying on memory. Breaks are allowed in case studies, but you cannot return to questions seen before the break.
Microsoft Learn buttonOn associate and expert exams Microsoft Learn opens in a split screen (no extra time; Q&A, practice assessments and your profile are blocked). Use it only to confirm one detail with Ctrl+F; if you cannot find it in about 90 seconds, make your best choice and flag it.
BreaksThe clock keeps running during a break, and after a break you cannot go back to earlier questions. You cannot break in the middle of a lab or a problem/solution question set. Use the restroom before you start.
ReviewUse the review screen for flagged items. Change an answer only if you can name the specific fact that makes your first choice wrong.
